comments:
A few pages only are preserved at sNye mo bye mkhar chos sde. See [S635TW6P]: 62 (bslab btus kyi bsdus don zhig yod kyang shog ldeb gcig las mi 'dug | yang snye mo bye mkhar chos sde dgon du bslab btus kyi 'grel ba dang | spyod 'jug bsdus don | rgyud bla ma'i bsdus don gsum gyi dpe cha sngar yod kyang da lta shog ldeb kha shas las mi 'dug).
This corresponds to the item listed in [HMSTSJ7Q]: 44, bod 47, No. 2: phywa pa chos kyi seng ge'i rgyud bla ma'i bsdus don (bris rnying 'bru tsha).
name: spyod 'jug don bsdus
provenance: snye mo bye mkhar chos sde
